place: Layan, Tambon Choeng Thale, Thalang, Phuket, Thailand
title: Layan Hillside Wellness Villa Collection — 3 to 5 Beds, Andaman & Valley Views
blurb: An ultra-luxury villa collection on the hillside above Layan — Phuket's most exclusive coast, embraced by Sirinath National Park with panoramic valley and Andaman Sea views. A gated enclave of self-contained wellness estates from three to five bedrooms, each with its own pool and in-villa spa, sharing a residents' clubhouse. From THB 98,000,000.
detail:
Set high on the Layan hillside — Phuket's most sought-after stretch of coast — this is a gated collection of ultra-luxury wellness villas, gifted with the pure beauty of Sirinath National Park and framed by panoramic views across a vast valley to the Andaman Sea. The architecture balances quiet modernism with Thai craft: low, deep-eaved pavilions, warm timber screens and stone, floor-to-ceiling glass, and rooftop gardens that fold each home into the tropical canopy. Privacy, proportion and understated elegance run through the whole scheme.

Every villa is conceived as a self-contained retreat rather than a house — each is delivered with its own swimming pool and a suite of in-villa wellness amenities, which across the collection include private spa rooms, saunas, steam rooms, onsen baths, fitness rooms and home theatres. Show and back kitchens, a maid's room with separate circulation, a study and covered parking come as standard, and living spaces open completely to pool terraces and the view. Residents also share a dedicated clubhouse and landscaped grounds within the enclave.

The collection offers twelve villas across six plot types, from intimate three-bedroom homes to sprawling five-bedroom estates. Indicative pre-launch pricing, by plot type:

Type A — 5 bed / 6 bath
Villa 1A — 1,711 m² plot — THB 273,000,000
Villa 2A — 2,071 m² plot — THB 285,000,000

Type B — 4 bed / 5 bath
Villa 1B — Sold
Villa 2B — 753 m² plot — THB 162,000,000
Villa 3B — 753 m² plot — THB 162,000,000

Type C — 4 bed / 5 bath
Villa 1C — 1,593 m² plot — THB 235,000,000

Type D — 3 bed / 4 bath
Villa 1D — 691 m² plot — THB 115,000,000
Villa 2D — 608 m² plot — THB 98,000,000
Villa 3D — 689 m² plot — THB 115,000,000

Type E — 4 bed / 5 bath
Villa 1E — 1,593 m² plot — THB 206,000,000

Type F — 3 bed / 4 bath
Villa 1F — 1,136 m² plot — THB 142,500,000
Villa 2F — 897 m² plot — THB 136,000,000
Villa 3F — 1,714 m² plot — THB 158,000,000

Built-up areas range from roughly 813 m² for the three-bedroom villas to 1,718 m² for the five-bedroom estates, with private pools up to around 517 m². Purchase is on a staged construction payment plan — a 2% reservation deposit, 28% on signing the sale and purchase agreement, and the balance released across build milestones through to handover. A short drive reaches Layan and Banana beaches, Laguna Phuket and the dining and lifestyle destinations of Bang Tao and Cherngtalay.
